notes: Kia USA Owners Portal 'Manuals' (https://owners.kia.com/us/en/manuals.html) is an Angular app (clientlib /etc.clientlibs/owners/designs/owners/angularJS/manuals/clientlib.js): model/year list via POST /apps/services/owners/apigwServlet.html service /cmm/gvmh, documents via /cmm/gam ('preLogin'); each PDF is opened by submitting a hidden form with a token to payload.manualsURL, so owners.kia.com exposes no direct owner's-manual PDF URLs. owners.kia.com/robots.txt disallows /apps/, /bin/, /api/ and /content/ for all user-agents, so those endpoints were not called and PDFs under owners.kia.com/content/dam were not requested. owners.kia.com/us/en/service-page/warranty.html says detailed Warranty and Consumer Information requires login to the Owner's Portal (account_required for current-year warranty booklets). Direct PDFs found: (1) Owner's Manual PDFs from Kia's official web-manual service ownersmanual.kia.com (robots.txt 'Allow: /'): public JSON API /api/v3/kia/model?modelName=..&countryCode=B28&langCode=en_US and /api/v2/kia/model/owners-manuals?projectCode=..&year=..&langCode=en_US&countryCode=B28 (B28 = 'U.S.A' per /api/v2/kia/country-lang-mappings/dealer). The API returned omManual.pdfManual for 3 entries (how='api'); the same /full_pdf/{projCode}/{year}/en_US form was then range-checked for every other projCode/year the API lists (how='pattern_verified'; missing ones return HTTP 500 and are not listed). Note the API names the US Forte 'Cerato' (YD/BD/BDM). (2) General 'Warranty and Consumer Information Manual' PDFs 2014-2020 plus Optima Hybrid/PHEV variants on www.kia.com/us/content/dam/kia/us/en/images/warranty/manual/ (found by site search; the pattern {year}_warranty.pdf returned 404 for 2021-2026). (3) Vehicle Feature Tips PDFs 2018-2026 linked from https://owners.kia.com/us/en/vehicle-feature-tips.html (not range-checked: robots). (4) 2026 Features & Functions Guides on dealervideos.kia.com (no robots.txt; found by site search). All fetched PDFs were checked with Range bytes=0-1023 only. Also available (not PDFs, listed separately in 'web_manuals'): US English HTML web owner's manuals / digital QRGs on ownersmanual.kia.com for the years the API lists; QRG pages for different requested years can carry the same '26MY' title (API returns the current QRG). Out-of-range PDFs seen: K5 DL3 2027: https://ownersmanual.kia.com/full_pdf/DL3/2027/en_US (206 %PDF 11570923 bytes); Sportage (P)HEV NQ5KH 2027: https://ownersmanual.kia.com/full_pdf/NQ5KH/2027/en_US (206 %PDF 11991881 bytes). Other-market Kia documents seen, NOT listed as US: Kia Puerto Rico https://www.kia.com/pr/service/manual.html links owner's manual PDFs under www.kia.com/content/dam/kwcms/pr/es/manual/ (e.g. ManualdePropietario2019/Optima.pdf, Forte.pdf, Forte-Koup.pdf, ManualdePropietario2022/2023_K5_OM.pdf, 2023_Forte_OM.pdf, 2023_Rio_OM.pdf, 2023_Sorento_OM_compressed.pdf, 2023_Sportage_OM.pdf; not range-checked); Kia UK quick reference guides under www.kia.com/content/dam/kwcms/kme/uk/en/... (Sorento, Sportage); ownersmanual.kia.com also serves Canada (B06, en_CA/fr_CA) and Puerto Rico (B35) editions, not queried.
